caption: The drawing consists of various stylized floral and botanical motifs arranged across a plain, light beige background; the motifs include flowers, leaves, stems, and paisley-like shapes in a range of flat colors. The colors present in the artwork are yellow, deep blue, vibrant pink, muted blue, dark green, brown, and light red, as indicated by seven color swatches along the left edge of the image. The compositions of the motifs vary, with some appearing as single flowers or leaves, while others form larger, more complex clusters or stylized bouquets. Each motif uses combinations of the listed colors, with solid fills and no gradient shading. The motifs are distributed unevenly across the canvas, and there is a border around the entire drawing, marked by a thin yellow line. The objects lack outlines and intricate details, focusing on bold, simple shapes. In the lower right corner, there is a handwritten note with the text rendered in red ink.
title: Colcha
